name: Early Training Evaluation of Language Models
description: This task involves designing evaluation benchmarks to measure the early training progress of small language models (SLMs) in acquiring scientific knowledge, focusing on the 0-200 billion tokens training phase.

cr:input.name: Pre-trained Small Language Models and Checkpoints
cr:input.description: Three pre-trained small language models (0.5B, 1B, and 3B parameters) with intermediate checkpoints sampled during training up to 200 billion tokens. Models are trained on two datasets: a Web-only dataset derived from FineWeb and a Scientific Knowledge Data Mixture combining subsets of FineWeb-edu, The Stack V1 and V2, InfiMM, and TxT360.

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: The expected output includes performance signals for early training stages of SLMs, such as rankings of models based on their scientific knowledge acquisition and reasoning capabilities.

field.name: model_size
field.description: The size of the model being evaluated (e.g., 0.5B, 1B, 3B).

field.name: architecture_variant
field.description: The architectural variant of the model (e.g., arch1, arch2).

field.name: performance_signal
field.description: The performance signal (e.g., zeta_score) indicating the model's progress in early training stages.

field.name: evaluation_metric
field.description: The evaluation metric used to assess the model (e.g., MMLU-var, GPQA, MATH).
